title: Prior Authorization Annual Limit and the Under-21 Exemption
content:
## Rule

Where a Prior Authorization class applies an annual limit, the units granted to one Prairie Ridge Health Plan member in a calendar year for the same class and the same limit basis may not exceed the class's annual unit limit, counting every authorization of the member together. An approval or extension that would pass the limit is granted only up to the units left, and a request with no units left is denied with the denial reason "annual limit reached". Members under age 21 on the requested start date are exempt from the annual limit and from the class's most units per approval where the class exempts members under 21, and their units are granted as medically necessary.

## How the units already counted are measured

- **Year:** the calendar year, January 1 through December 31, of the requested start date.
- **Authorizations counted:** every authorization of the member in the same class and with the same limit-basis value (the therapy discipline for therapy; the service type otherwise) whose start date falls in that year.
- **Units counted:** the units granted on those authorizations, less the units released from them.

## Units that can be granted

The units left are the class's annual unit limit less the units already counted, and never below zero. Where the class applies an annual limit, the units granted are the smaller of the units being approved and the units left. Where the class applies no annual limit, the units being approved are granted without reference to the year's count.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Hypothetical case | Units already counted in the year | Units being approved | Units left | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member aged 40, class limit 30, same discipline | 24 | 12 | 6 | 6 units granted |
| Member aged 40, class limit 30, same discipline | 30 | 12 | 0 | denied, reason "annual limit reached" |
| Member aged 40, class limit 30, same discipline | 10 | 12 | 20 | 12 units granted |
| Member aged 17 on the requested start date, class exempts under 21 | 30 | 12 | not applied | granted as medically necessary |

In the second row nothing is left, so the request is denied rather than granted at zero. In the fourth row neither the annual limit nor the most units per approval is applied.
